notes: Canonical URL per openai.com release sitemap: https://openai.com/index/introducing-o3-and-o4-mini/ (the older /index/openai-o3-and-o4-mini/ slug now 404s). Release date 2025-04-16 printed on page. All benchmark numbers machine-read from the page's embedded vega-lite chart specs in the RSC payload (balanced-JSON parse; NOT OCR, NOT image reading), cross-anchored with prose values (o3 AIME-2025-with-python 98.4% pass@1, o4-mini 99.5% pass@1 / 100% cons@8). Footnotes captured: (1) 'All SWE-bench evaluation runs use a fixed subset of n=477 verified tasks validated on our internal infrastructure'; (2) instruction-following/agentic-tool-use charts evaluated at high reasoning effort (similar to o4-mini-high in ChatGPT); (3) tool-assisted AIME results must not be compared to no-tools models. Not extracted (documented here instead): an Aider Polyglot chart exists in the payload but its data arrays are split by task type with an unexplained second series, so no row was created; static image charts o3-o4_mini_GPQA-Pass.png / o3-o4_mini_AIME2025.png (with-tools configurations) are image-only. Page update 2025-06-10: o3-pro released to ChatGPT Pro and API (no separate benchmark table on this page). WebFetch and web-reader both failed on openai.com (403 / soft-404); headless-browser extraction succeeded.
